Question B-005-007-004.

Why the correct answer is right: 7125 kHz is 7.125 MHz. The HF range covers 3 MHz to 30 MHz, so 7.125 MHz is High Frequency.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Low Frequency (LF)": LF is far below 7.125 MHz, so the converted frequency is not in that range.
- sourceIndex 2: "Medium frequency (MF)": MF is below HF; 7.125 MHz is above the medium-frequency range.
- sourceIndex 3: "Very High Frequency (VHF)": VHF begins above HF. A 7.125 MHz signal has not reached VHF.
